skill_name: What are the advantages of using a cloud-native architecture?
workflow: The advantages of using a cloud-native architecture include scalability, high availability, cost efficiency, and agility. Cloud-native architecture allows for applications to be built on cloud infrastructure, which makes it easier to scale up and down on demand to meet the changing needs of users. It also provides automatic fault tolerance and high availability, ensuring that applications remain available even in the event of system or network failure.
